title: OmoAgent `removeAgent` should not remove agent with positive debt
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  The `removeAgent()` function currently allows the removal of an agent even if the agent has a positive debt. This could lead to an inconsistent or incorrect state in contract:  ```solidity     function removeAgent(uint256 _id) external onlyManager {         delete OmoAgentStorage.data().agents[_id];     } ```  ## Recommendations  Check `agentDebts` before removing an agent.
